findings.description: The brycg definition/stem line is alone at the end of page 13, with its diagnostic table on page 14. The gewrit line similarly ends page 14 before its table on page 15. Table captions eventually identify the lemma, but the defining lead is detached from the diagnostic row it introduces. The same pattern recurs for mūð at pages 17–18 and fōt at pages 18–19. Brād is similarly introduced at the foot of page 20 before the fully captioned paradigms on page 21. Ēadig is introduced on page 22 before its tables on page 23; mildheort ends page 23 before subsequent content. The coordinator confirmed this page-break issue and plans space reservations before lexical leads.
